title: Invoice calculator
issue: Customers report that some invoices are a cent or more off, and that orders with a discount seem to be charged too much tax. The test suite is red. Make the library follow its README.

bugs.summary: toCents truncates with Math.floor, so 19.99 becomes 1998 cents; it must round to the nearest cent.
Tax is computed on the undiscounted subtotal; it must be charged on subtotal minus discount.
